text:
In esta hora lívida of the primavera, al caer the afternoon,

después of a reciente lluvia, the flowers

brotan in the jardín

claras and misteriosas,

and oigo carreras in the calle, después silencio, siento the

soledad herirme,

and ahora pasos and voces. Cesan. Canta a muchacho,

and adivino in his eyes the farewell of esta light cansada,

of este day terrible

to tantos, mientras his voz itself aleja for the night.


Ahora that no there is felicidad, quiero encontrar a rostro

that refleje his light, to look caer the night

sobre the campo dormido, to hear cantar a pájaro

with dulzura inocente.

And ahora that of ella nada queda in mí,

I quiero contemplarla

in lo that existe and the retiene,

and with eyes serene me asomo a the ventana to to see

a hombre with a perro, conversando unos niños, a

balcón encendido.


There is a sordo pain ante este frío oscuro that itself agolpa

more allá of the horas of the life,

and busco a rostro that refleje light,

alguien that, as I, teniendo death only,

tenga also, as tuviera I,

venciéndola, the life.


The niños itself dispersan, the balcón itself ha apagado, itself

hunde in the night the hombre with his perro.
